title: 32-head DAgger twins on validation: iterations 19, 39 and 59 of net2 (r27-means) and neto2 (r28), 29 policies
description: Rounds 27 and 28 train round 25's and round 26's online DAgger recipes unchanged on the 32-head estimators, which add back five composite heads (departure rate, available capacity, overload max(y - C, 0), BDP and the other flows' arrival rate): net2 on net1 v10's means (exp-net1v10-266) and neto2 on neto1 v3 (exp-neto1-v3-264) with the rule at u = 0.25 or 0.375 as teacher. As for the 27-head twins (exp-dagger-twins-iter-val-256), the iteration is chosen on validation for both sides alike: this run evaluates every training seed of r27-means, r28-u0.25 and r28-u0.375 after iterations 19, 39 and 59 (27 policies, named ARM-iN-sSEED), beside BBRv3 and, as reference lines only, the rule on net1 v10 at u = 0.25 (rule-v10) and on neto1 v3 at u = 0.375 (rule-v3), on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies, campaign seed 21. Each arm's iteration is the one with the best mean over its three training seeds on the five families; the chosen arms are then confirmed at campaign seeds 11 and 31 beside the 27-head twins' chosen arms, before a single test run. The policies are model-dagger32-cands, copied unchanged from the two training releases. Validation links only; no claim about the test links.
prepare: N10="$IN/v10/$(cat "$IN/v10/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; N3="$IN/v3/$(cat "$IN/v3/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v10" "$N10" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v3" "$N3" --u 0.375; P=(--policy "rule-v10=$OUT/v10/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "rule-v3=$OUT/v3/rule-u0.375.onnx"); (cd "$IN/x" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); for f in "$IN"/x/ppo-*.onnx; do n="$(basename "$f" .onnx)"; n="${n#ppo-}"; it="${n##*-}"; b="${n%-*}"; P+=(--policy "${b%-*}-$it-${b##*-}=$f"); done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 58 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s --best r27-means-i19 r27-means-i39 r27-means-i59 r28-u0.25-i19 r28-u0.25-i39 r28-u0.25-i59 r28-u0.375-i19 r28-u0.375-i39 r28-u0.375-i59 && uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" rule-v10
